newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs mostly lower, market awaits EIA data.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs mostly lower, market awaits EIA data.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were mostly lower in quiet trade on Wednesday as the market waited for the release later today of government inventory data.
Players said they were expecting bearish numbers on propane, which could bring values down late Wednesday and Thursday morning.
Spot propane was down in the U.S. Gulf Coast and steady in Conway, Kansas, but the out months were firmly down by a quarter to half cent.
"Players are waiting to see if the direction on the market will be bearish," said a Conway player. "There is more activity on the out months than on the spot barrels."
Belvieu propane was pegged 34.25/34.50 cents and Conway at 36.00/36.25 cents. 36.00-cent parcels were sold.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
